item.title: War in the Middle East live: Explosions heard over Tel Aviv as Israel strikes Beirut suburbs, Tehran
item.summary: Israeli air defence systems were working to intercept strikes over Tel Aviv on Monday, the military said, as Israel launched its own strikes on both the southern suburbs of Beirut and the Iranian capital. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei, son and successor to Iran's supreme leader?
item.summary: Iran's Assembly of Experts has named Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father Ali Khamenei as the country's supreme leader, signalling that hardliners remain firmly in charge in Tehran more than a week into its conflict with the United States and Israel.
